**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **What I checked:** Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation, ¶¶ p0013–p0015), the only pricing provision, plus document-wide searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favourable", "favorable", "best price", "discount", "rates", "match", and "terms offered to any other".
- **Result:** No most-favoured-nation covenant exists in either direction. Compensation runs per Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, with the sole pricing mechanic being RadialSpark's right to change rates on 30 days' notice.
- **Direction analysis:** Clear Capital takes on no obligation to extend RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers. That satisfies the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer).
- **Note, not a deviation:** There is also no vendor-granted MFN in our favour. Under this directional rule that is not flaggable, but it is worth raising commercially if pricing is ever renegotiated — particularly given the unilateral rate-change right in p0014, which is a separate pricing-governance point rather than an MFN issue.
